result:
PR #244 is marked ready for review. The Thor arm passed, and the only thing left before it can fold is CI on the new head `a105a32af2`.

- **Arm result:** PASS on W buffering and Depth Clamp (base `d709a8d1fa`, fix `9848c0f227`). All 570 captures are byte-identical between the two arms, nothing moved, and the exact count stayed at 116.
- **Checks the brief asked for:** both arms' `scores1.tsv` status columns are identical (ok 500, white-content 59, label-differs 9, blank 2), with no `unreadable`. Neither `run1.log` contains UtilAcceptVsock or PARTIAL COVERAGE.
- **Why the previous attempt didn't finish:** it stopped correctly while waiting for the re-registered arm and for CI. CI then came back green on `09cfd49a7b`. This is now recorded in `docs/lanes/wbuf31sel/NOTES.md`.
- **New conflict:** master had moved 91 commits ahead, and the PR conflicted again, only on `nv2a_index.json`. I merged master as `b77e03eb78` and regenerated the index over the pinned trees (tests 6743b6a, pbkit e91d509); the index check passes. `psh.c` and `wbuf_anchor_recover.py` have not changed since the commit the arm tested, so the verdict still applies, and I did not re-register the prediction.
- **Definition of done:** preflight passes with `--allow-tracker`. The `Files:` line matches the branch diff. I updated the PR body (through the REST API) with the new base line and the verdict.

One limit, also stated in the PR body: ClipF-300-008 is not on the golden disc, so the arm only shows that nothing moved. The evidence that the fix is right is the offline float32 simulation of the console capture.

The first push was rejected with a generic "failed"; the second attempt pushed normally. I posted a `[lane.wbuf31sel] ready:` comment on the PR.
